howto.name: Upload a video
howto.text: MP4 / MOV / MKV / WebM up to 500 MB.

howto.name: Choose timestamp
howto.text: Time in seconds (e.g. 5.5 = 5.5 seconds in). Default is the middle of the video.

howto.name: Download the frame as PNG
howto.text: FFmpeg extracts the exact frame at that timestamp.

faq.q: How do I find a good thumbnail moment?
faq.a: Trial and error — try different timestamps to find a visually interesting frame. For automated 'best' selection, use Video to PDF and pick from the keyframe samples.

faq.q: What resolution will the PNG be?
faq.a: Same as the source video's resolution. Use Resize Crop Image after if you need a specific size for social media.

faq.q: Can I extract multiple thumbnails at once?
faq.a: Yes — Video to PDF extracts multiple keyframes and lays them out as PDF pages.
